title: Annex A.5 - Assessing impacts of AI systems
description: Working paper for Annex A.5: AI system impact assessment process, outcome documentation, individuals/groups assessment.

sections.title: Impact assessment process (A.5.2)
prompts: Verify a documented impact assessment methodology exists.
Confirm the methodology covers fairness, accountability, transparency, environmental impact.
Check methodology references EU AI Act / NIST AI RMF where applicable.

sections.title: Documented impact assessment (A.5.3)
prompts: Verify sign-off authority and review cadence.
Confirm documentation is retained for the documented period.

sections.title: Impacts on individuals, groups, society (A.5.4)
prompts: Verify the impact analysis explicitly addresses affected populations.
Confirm bias / fairness considerations are documented.

checklists.text: Impact assessments exist for each in-scope AI system.
Impact assessment template covers groups + society.
Impact assessments have sign-off and review dates.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Walk us through your impact assessment for an in-scope AI system.
How do you involve affected stakeholders?
How do you decide an AI system needs an impact assessment?
